graphs.title: The wave speed rises in a straight line as the frequency rises.
graphs.label: Wave speed

sentences: Keep the wavelength at its starting value and move the frequency from its smallest to its largest.
title: Wave speed: frequency and wavelength
goal: See how the speed of a wave depends on its frequency and its wavelength.
note: The speed of a wave is the frequency multiplied by the wavelength: v = f x wavelength. In a real medium the speed is fixed by the medium, so changing the frequency changes the wavelength. Here you can set both to see the product.

predict.prompt: If the wavelength stays the same and the frequency doubles, what happens to the wave speed?
predict.reveal: Set the frequency to its starting value, then to double that, and watch the speed.

concept_check.question: A wave has a frequency of 5 Hz and a wavelength of 2 m. What is its speed?
concept_check.explanation: Speed is frequency times wavelength, so 5 Hz times 2 m gives 10 m/s.
